name: PawGroove
tagline: Turn one dog photo into a short vertical dance video
description: I maintain PawGroove, an image-to-video web tool for pet owners and social video creators. A dog photo and a template produce a short vertical dance clip. Most clips run about ten seconds, and the site shows public examples. Clips start silent. Supported templates offer optional music afterward. Eligible new accounts may receive welcome credits for one clip. Further use requires credits.
